title: YOLO-Based Obstacle Detection
summary: Real-time obstacle detection system using YOLO architecture for autonomous navigation applications.

caseStudy.problem: Develop a real-time obstacle detection system for autonomous vehicles and robotics applications that can identify and classify obstacles with high accuracy and low latency.
caseStudy.approach: Implemented YOLO (You Only Look Once) architecture with custom dataset training, optimized for real-time inference using TensorFlow and OpenCV pipeline.
caseStudy.implementation: Built custom YOLO model with transfer learning, implemented real-time video processing pipeline, integrated with ROS for robotics applications, and deployed on edge devices.
caseStudy.results: Achieved 94.2% mAP (mean Average Precision) with 30 FPS inference speed on NVIDIA Jetson Nano, reducing false positives by 23% compared to baseline models.
caseStudy.learnings: Model optimization and pre/post-processing techniques are crucial for real-time performance. Edge deployment requires careful consideration of computational constraints.
caseStudy.modelArchitecture: YOLO v5 with CSPDarknet53 backbone, SPP module, and PANet neck. Custom head with 3 detection scales optimized for obstacle classes.
caseStudy.dataPipeline: Automated data collection from multiple sensors, data augmentation pipeline (rotation, scaling, lighting), and validation split ensuring class balance across environments.
caseStudy.performanceMetrics: mAP@0.5: 94.2%, mAP@0.5:0.95: 87.6%, Precision: 91.8%, Recall: 89.4%, FPS: 30, Model Size: 45MB
caseStudy.deployment: Docker containerization, ROS integration, edge deployment on Jetson Nano, real-time monitoring dashboard, and automated retraining pipeline.

title: Insect and Plant Disease Detection
summary: AI-powered system for identifying insect pests and plant diseases to help farmers make informed decisions.

caseStudy.problem: Farmers struggle to identify plant diseases and insect pests early, leading to crop losses. Need for automated, accurate classification system accessible via mobile devices.
caseStudy.approach: Developed custom CNN architecture using transfer learning from pre-trained models, with extensive data augmentation and ensemble methods for robust classification.
caseStudy.implementation: Built ResNet50-based model with custom head, implemented data augmentation pipeline, created mobile-friendly API, and developed farmer-facing mobile app.
caseStudy.results: Achieved 96.8% accuracy on test set, reduced identification time from 2-3 days to 2-3 minutes, deployed to 500+ farmers with 89% user satisfaction.
caseStudy.learnings: Data quality and diversity are critical for agricultural applications. Mobile deployment requires careful optimization of model size and inference speed.
caseStudy.modelArchitecture: ResNet50 backbone with custom classification head, attention mechanisms for disease localization, and ensemble of 3 models for improved robustness.
caseStudy.dataPipeline: Multi-source data collection (field cameras, expert annotations), automated preprocessing, data augmentation (rotation, scaling, color jittering), and stratified sampling.
caseStudy.performanceMetrics: Accuracy: 96.8%, Precision: 95.2%, Recall: 94.7%, F1-Score: 94.9%, Inference Time: 2.3s, Model Size: 28MB
caseStudy.deployment: Flask API backend, React Native mobile app, cloud deployment on AWS, automated model updates, and farmer feedback integration system.

title: Equipment Maintenance
summary: Predictive maintenance system using IoT sensors and machine learning to optimize industrial equipment maintenance schedules.

caseStudy.problem: Industrial equipment failures cause costly downtime. Traditional maintenance schedules are inefficient and don't account for actual equipment condition.
caseStudy.approach: Implemented IoT sensor network for real-time monitoring, developed LSTM-based anomaly detection models, and created predictive maintenance scheduling system.
caseStudy.implementation: Deployed IoT sensors (vibration, temperature, pressure), built data pipeline for sensor data processing, trained LSTM models for anomaly detection, and integrated with maintenance management system.
caseStudy.results: Reduced unexpected failures by 67%, increased equipment uptime by 23%, saved $450K annually in maintenance costs, and improved maintenance efficiency by 41%.
caseStudy.learnings: Feature engineering from time-series sensor data is crucial. Domain expertise is essential for interpreting model predictions and setting appropriate thresholds.
caseStudy.modelArchitecture: LSTM with attention mechanism, 1D CNN for feature extraction, and ensemble of multiple models for different equipment types and failure modes.
caseStudy.dataPipeline: Real-time IoT data collection, data preprocessing and normalization, feature engineering (statistical features, frequency domain analysis), and continuous model retraining.
caseStudy.performanceMetrics: Anomaly Detection Accuracy: 92.3%, False Positive Rate: 7.8%, Prediction Horizon: 2-4 weeks, Data Processing Latency: <5s, Model Update Frequency: Weekly
caseStudy.deployment: Edge computing deployment, cloud-based model training, real-time alerting system, integration with CMMS, and automated model performance monitoring.

title: Offshore Engineering
summary: Advanced simulation and analysis system for offshore structures using finite element analysis and machine learning optimization.

caseStudy.problem: Offshore platform design requires complex structural analysis under various environmental loads. Manual optimization is time-consuming and may miss optimal solutions.
caseStudy.approach: Developed automated finite element analysis pipeline with machine learning-based optimization for structural design parameters and load case analysis.
caseStudy.implementation: Built FEA framework using Python, implemented genetic algorithm optimization, integrated environmental load modeling, and created automated reporting system.
caseStudy.results: Reduced design iteration time by 78%, improved structural efficiency by 15%, identified 23% cost savings in material usage, and enhanced safety factor calculations.
caseStudy.learnings: Complex simulations require robust computational resources and parallel processing. ML optimization can significantly accelerate engineering design processes.
caseStudy.modelArchitecture: Finite Element Analysis with Python-based solver, genetic algorithm optimization, and ensemble of ML models for load prediction and structural response.
caseStudy.dataPipeline: Environmental data collection (wave, wind, current), structural geometry parameterization, automated mesh generation, and parallel computation framework.
caseStudy.performanceMetrics: Simulation Accuracy: 98.7%, Optimization Convergence: 95.2%, Computation Time Reduction: 78%, Design Iterations: Reduced from 15 to 3
caseStudy.deployment: High-performance computing cluster, automated workflow management, cloud-based collaboration platform, and integration with CAD software.

title: Electrical Wiring
summary: Automated electrical wiring design and optimization system for industrial and commercial applications.

caseStudy.problem: Electrical system design is manual, error-prone, and doesn't always result in optimal solutions. Need for automated design with constraint satisfaction.
caseStudy.approach: Developed constraint-based optimization algorithm for electrical wiring design, integrated with CAD systems, and implemented automated validation and cost optimization.
caseStudy.implementation: Built Python-based optimization engine, integrated with AutoCAD API, implemented electrical code compliance checking, and created automated BOM generation.
caseStudy.results: Reduced design errors by 89%, decreased design time by 65%, optimized material costs by 18%, and improved compliance with electrical codes by 95%.
caseStudy.learnings: Balancing automation with human oversight is crucial. Domain-specific constraints and regulations must be carefully encoded in optimization algorithms.
caseStudy.modelArchitecture: Constraint satisfaction problem solver, graph-based routing algorithms, and rule-based validation system for electrical code compliance.
caseStudy.dataPipeline: CAD drawing parsing, constraint definition, optimization algorithm execution, and automated validation and reporting.
caseStudy.performanceMetrics: Design Accuracy: 96.8%, Time Reduction: 65%, Cost Optimization: 18%, Compliance Rate: 95%, Error Reduction: 89%
caseStudy.deployment: Desktop application with AutoCAD integration, cloud-based optimization engine, automated validation system, and collaborative design platform.

title: Sentiment Analysis & NLP Platform
summary: Enterprise-grade natural language processing platform for sentiment analysis, text classification, and language understanding.

caseStudy.problem: Companies need to analyze customer feedback, social media posts, and support tickets at scale to understand sentiment and extract actionable insights from unstructured text data.
caseStudy.approach: Developed transformer-based NLP models using BERT and RoBERTa architectures, implemented multi-task learning for sentiment analysis, intent classification, and entity extraction.
caseStudy.implementation: Built custom BERT fine-tuning pipeline, created FastAPI backend with async processing, implemented Redis caching for performance, and developed real-time streaming analytics dashboard.
caseStudy.results: Achieved 94.7% accuracy on sentiment classification, processed 10M+ documents daily, reduced analysis time from hours to minutes, and provided real-time insights for customer service teams.
caseStudy.learnings: Transformer models require significant computational resources but provide superior performance. Caching and async processing are essential for real-time NLP applications.
caseStudy.modelArchitecture: BERT-base with custom classification head, RoBERTa for domain adaptation, attention mechanisms for interpretability, and ensemble methods for robustness.
caseStudy.dataPipeline: Multi-source text data ingestion, automated preprocessing and cleaning, data augmentation techniques, continuous model retraining, and A/B testing framework.
caseStudy.performanceMetrics: Sentiment Accuracy: 94.7%, Intent Classification: 92.3%, Entity Recognition: 89.8%, Processing Speed: 1000 docs/sec, Model Latency: <50ms
caseStudy.deployment: Kubernetes cluster deployment, auto-scaling based on load, real-time monitoring with Prometheus, automated model updates, and multi-region deployment for global access.
